name: Azure Fleet Admiral
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you become the monarch.
This creature can't be blocked by creatures the monarch controls.
blocked_sentences: This creature can't be blocked by creatures the monarch controls.

needs.what: a blocker-filter controller spec on the block_restriction static's `blockers` that matches creatures controlled by whoever is currently the monarch (e.g. `blockers: {"controller": "monarch"}`), read per blocker at declare-blockers time
needs.why_existing_wont_do: block_restriction's `blockers` is a static filter whose `controller` resolves through _static_players to only you/opponent/any; the static condition `is_monarch` only switches the whole static on or off for a fixed player spec (or `affected_controller`, which names the attacker's controller, not the blocker's), so `{is_monarch: opponent}` plus an unfiltered block_restriction would make it unblockable by every opponent's creatures in multiplayer, not just the monarch's
